message: local-lib is built from source when installed (it is a local directory), which runs its build code, but depcurfew.json denies it, and Pipenv builds local directory dependencies whatever its settings say
fix: Replace local-lib with a registry release that has wheels, or move "pypi:local-lib" from installScripts.deny to installScripts.allow in depcurfew.json after reviewing it

message: sampleproject is built from source when installed (it comes from a git repository), which runs its build code, but depcurfew.json does not allow it
fix: Review sampleproject and add "pypi:sampleproject" to installScripts.allow in depcurfew.json (it is then always built from source), or replace the package
